decision.why: Bug fix with a clear reproduction in a repo with tests (140 test files). Confined to TrieRouter matching, so one module. Medium effort, one step above the mechanical default, because the fix needs reasoning about wildcard ordering and regex-literal prefixes.

checks.reason: The existing router and hono tests pass: 769 passed, 22 skipped. My own throwaway test also passed. It covered `/assets*` with a `:param` sibling, registration in both orders alongside `/assets*/x`, the literal regex prefix (`/file.+*` matches `/file.+js` but not `/fileZZjs`), and a suffix wildcard after a `:param` segment.

denied.command:

it('a',()=>{
 expect(m([['/assets*/x','x'],['/assets*','a']],'/assets/app.js')).toEqual(['a'])
